scene.note: Your copy asks the server what is new, then takes it into your own branches.

steps.note: Overnight Femi and Wilma sent new commits to the server.
Your copy still remembers the server as it was, so git status says up to date.
A fetch asks the server and moves the origin/ names. Your branches stay as they were.
main is behind origin/main by Femi's two commits.
You read the new commits before you take them.
main moves forward to take them in, with no merge commit.
Your branch has your fix, and the server's has Wilma's link: they have diverged.
A pull fetches, then merges the server's branch into yours.
A merge commit joins your fix and Wilma's link. main does not have either.
